verdict.statement: Vaporize v0.0.1 should remain in release prep until substrate-owned Apple project-generation truth moves from XcodeGen project.yml surfaces to a Pkl-backed owned .xcodeproj world-state path, with any remaining XcodeGen surfaces explicitly quarantined as compatibility or historical evidence. The Swift YAML read bridge, Pkl parity specimen, PklSwift-backed transitional YAML generation slice, YAML-to-Pkl import slice, and first Pkl-backed .xcodeproj generation slice and target discovery slice are landed as migration evidence, not as final fleet build parity.
verdict.why: The tree has broad project.yml and checked-in pbxproj reliance plus direct XcodeGen runner code. Releasing Vaporize as an internal essential tool before owned Pkl-backed .xcodeproj generation or explicit quarantine would teach assistants the wrong project-generation boundary.

recommendedMigrationPlan: Freeze: do not add new substrate-owned project.yml surfaces unless they are explicitly marked legacy-compatibility.
Read bridge: use Vaporize inspect-project-yml as the quarantined Swift intake surface for legacy project.yml parity evidence.
Model: author an AppleProjectSpec Pkl module for the common project.yml shape: options, settings, packages, targets, sources, info, scripts, schemes, and configurations.

Shadow parity: for wrkstrm-core apps, express existing project.yml as Pkl and prove equivalence before project world-state generation. Concourse covers Pkl-to-YAML parity and Creative Selection v0.2 covers YAML-to-Pkl import parity.
Owned generator: expand the Swift-owned generator path that consumes Pkl-evaluated project data and writes the .xcodeproj world-state with receipts.
Target and cache-candidate discovery: use list-targets receipts to choose the next build, cache, parity, or migration route before claiming automatic .xcworkspace graph membership discovery.
Vaporize integration: extend generate-xcodeproj until it owns Pkl evaluation, project world-state generation, receipt emission, and app build/install composition.
Cutover: migrate wrkstrm-core apps first, then generator/scaffold surfaces, then wrkstrm-app and wrkstrm-components fleet surfaces.
Quarantine: tag any remaining XcodeGen path as historical, external, or compatibility-only; make release gates fail on unclassified substrate-owned XcodeGen use.
doNotDo: Do not mark XcodeGen integration as the forward canonical Vaporize release path.
Do not mechanically rename project.yml to a Pkl file without a typed model and generation receipt.
Do not let app runners invoke xcodegen directly after Vaporize owns the lane.
Do not claim v0.0.1 is internally releasable while Pkl project-generation evidence is missing.
nextConcreteWork: Expand Pkl-backed .xcodeproj world-state generation and target discovery beyond Creative Selection v0.2.
Add a Vaporize bead for release-gate enforcement that scans for unclassified substrate-owned XcodeGen invocations.
Update versioned-macos-app-install workflow tool refs from xcodegen to Vaporize/Pkl generation once the owned mode exists.
